create_voice_config: create a voice entry in the YAML config by providing a WAV sample file path
build_voice_with_language: build a voice config entry with a specific language such as en, es, fr, de, ja, or zh-cn
run_voice_with_custom_model: run the add_voice tool using a custom XTTS model and model path
test_voice_with_custom_name: test adding a voice with a custom name instead of deriving from the WAV filename
review_voice_config_update: review the updated voice_to_speaker.yaml config after adding a new voice entry
